sentence: Being early is no advantage in itself: market value and financial performance rise with implementation, but the edge of first movers and top performers is not uniform across the indicators
passage: [Huang & Lin (2025), p. 1856] "this research reveals that while AI adoption enhances financial performance and market value, the advantages for AI first movers and better performers are not uniformly positive across all indicators."

gemini.overclaim: Being early is no advantage in itself
gemini.note: The passage states that advantages for first movers are not uniformly positive, which does not fully support the stronger claim that being early offers no advantage in itself.
